description: Attach to an already-running Electron app exposing a CDP debug endpoint (use electron_discover_running to find one, or start the app with --remote-debugging-port). Provide port (+ optional loopback host) or a loopback cdpUrl; pid alone is not attachable over CDP but, when supplied alongside, lets stop escalate to SIGKILL. The CDP transport supports eval/read/observe and core interaction surfaces against the attached app. The selected CDP page is also the default snapshot/find surface; explicit iframe/webview surface targeting remains unavailable. Returns: { ok, session_id, transport, windows, capabilities }. Errors: TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED (no attach-capable transport), CDP_DISCONNECTED (endpoint unreachable or dropped; retryable), CDP_TIMEOUT (handshake/method timeout; retryable), BAD_ARGUMENT (missing target selector or non-loopback endpoint).

cdpUrl.description: Full CDP WebSocket URL on a loopback host.

host.description: Loopback host for port-based attach. Defaults to localhost.

pid.description: Process id of the running app.

port.description: CDP port; the endpoint is resolved from /json/version.

timeoutMs.description: Max wait for the attach handshake.

name: electron_attach
title: Attach to running Electron app
